fun_fact: Cocoa cultivation is threatened by climate change — rising heat and erratic rainfall are shrinking harvests across West Africa, where most of the world's cocoa is grown. To spotlight the risk, scientists in the UK have made the first all-British chocolate bar in nearly 100 years, using cocoa grown at the University of Reading. Read more [here](https://www.theguardian.com/food/2026/aug/12/all-british-chocolate-bar-made-by-scientists-using-reading-grown-cocoa).
